topic: NBI filing SEA Games probe 7 years late while Cayetano remains senator
tweet1: NBI creates 'Task Force Cash Cow' to probe 2019 SEA Games anomalies — seven years after the event, while Alan Peter Cayetano, who chaired it, investigates ghost projects in the Senate.
tweet2: Philippine Star reports NBI just formed the task force. Lacson's committee is investigating alleged Taguig ghost projects — Cayetano territory. The irony: Cayetano ran the SEA Games budget everyone questioned.
tweet3: Pulse Asia shows 71% want impeachment rulings based on law, not politics. Yet prosecutors investigating 2019 took until 2026 to act — long after the political cost became manageable for everyone involved.
tweet4: Pattern's clear: investigations launch when subjects no longer hold executive power or when probes serve current political needs. Has anyone tracked which 2019 SEA Games cases actually reached Sandiganbayan?
